title: Self-referential processes and emotion regulation in dissociative seizures and epilepsy
summary: The current study is a project for extensive research into neurobiological and psychological mechanisms of self-referential processes and emotion regulation in dissociative seizures and epilepsy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Three groups will be studied:
30 patients with epilepsy only (ICD-10: G40.X)
18 patients with dissociative seizures only (F44.5)
30 healthy controls 
Additional inclusion criteria:
- Age 18-80 years
- Sufficient knowledge of German
- Ability to answer questionnaires and psychological tests on a PC
- Confirmed diagnosis 
- Informed oral and written consent
Exclusion criteria:
-Intelligence impairment
-(Comorbid) relevant neurological disorder
-(Comorbid) severe relevant psychiatric disorder in epilepsy (e.g. suicidal intentions, psychotic disorders, severe addiction)
-Current psychotherapy in healthy controls (> 5 sessions).
